name: Bench: ItalicizeSupraInNotes italicizes note occurrences only with one-step undo

steps.name: Run and inspect notes and body

operation.value:
Dim d As Document, n As Footnote, r As Range, total As Long, italicHits As Long
Set d = ActiveDocument
d.TrackRevisions = False
d.Content.Text = "Body supra text"
Set n = d.Footnotes.Add(d.Range(15, 15), , "See supra note 1 and Supra note 2 but not suprapubic.")
Application.ScreenUpdating = True
Application.Run "ItalicizeSupraInNotes"
Set r = d.Footnotes(1).Range.Duplicate
With r.Find
.ClearFormatting
.Text = "supra"
.MatchCase = False
.MatchWholeWord = True
.MatchWildcards = False
.Forward = True
.Wrap = wdFindStop
End With
Do While r.Find.Execute
total = total + 1
If r.Font.Italic = True Then italicHits = italicHits + 1
r.Collapse wdCollapseEnd
Loop
Dim suprapubic As Range
Set suprapubic = d.Footnotes(1).Range.Duplicate
With suprapubic.Find
.ClearFormatting
.Text = "suprapubic"
.MatchWholeWord = True
.Wrap = wdFindStop
End With
suprapubic.Find.Execute
Evaluate = Array(total, italicHits, d.Range(5, 10).Font.Italic, Application.ScreenUpdating, suprapubic.Font.Italic, d.Range(5, 10).Text)

Dim d As Document, r As Range, italicHits As Long, undone As Boolean
Set d = ActiveDocument
undone = d.Undo
Set r = d.Footnotes(1).Range.Duplicate
With r.Find
.ClearFormatting
.Text = "supra"
.MatchCase = False
.MatchWholeWord = True
.Forward = True
.Wrap = wdFindStop
End With
Do While r.Find.Execute
If r.Font.Italic = True Then italicHits = italicHits + 1
r.Collapse wdCollapseEnd
Loop
Evaluate = Array(undone, italicHits)
